+"""Read-only projections for versioned OpenCode mutation tools."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final, Literal
+
+from slopgate._types import ObjectDict, ObjectMapping, string_value
+
+OPENCODE_TOOL_CONTRACT_VERSION: Final = "1.18.19"
+PROJECTION_KEY: Final = "_slopgate_projection"
+
+type ProjectionStatus = Literal["projected", "invalid", "stale", "unsupported"]
+type PatchOperation = Literal["add", "update", "delete"]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Snapshot:
+    content: str
+    sha256: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _ProjectedFile:
+    path: str
+    content: str
+    operation: str
+    preimage_sha256: str | None
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> ObjectDict:
+        return {
+            "path": self.path,
+            "content": self.content,
+            "operation": self.operation,
+            "preimage_sha256": self.preimage_sha256,
+        }
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _Projection:
+    status: ProjectionStatus
+    files: tuple[_ProjectedFile, ...] = ()
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> ObjectDict:
+        return {
+            "status": self.status,
+            "contract_version": OPENCODE_TOOL_CONTRACT_VERSION,
+            "files": [item.to_dict() for item in self.files],
+        }
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _PatchSection:
+    operation: PatchOperation
+    path: str
+    lines: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+def _target(root: Path, value: str) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:
+    if not value.strip():
+        return None
+    root = root.resolve()
+    candidate = Path(value)
+    path = candidate.resolve() if candidate.is_absolute() else (root / candidate).resolve()
+    try:
+        relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    return path, relative
+
+
+def _snapshot(path: Path) -> tuple[ProjectionStatus, _Snapshot | None]:
+    try:
+        before = path.stat()
+        content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        after = path.stat()
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        return "invalid", None
+    except OSError:
+        return "stale", None
+    before_key = $SECRET before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns)
+    after_key = $SECRET after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns)
+    if before_key != after_key:
+        return "stale", None
+    return "projected", _Snapshot(
+        content=content,
+        sha256=hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest(),
+    )
+
+
+def _write(root: Path, tool_input: ObjectMapping) -> _Projection:
+    target = _target(root, string_value(tool_input.get("filePath")) or "")
+    content = string_value(tool_input.get("content"))
+    if target is None or content is None:
+        return _Projection("invalid")
+    path, relative = target
+    digest: str | None = None
+    if path.exists():
+        status, snapshot = _snapshot(path)
+        if snapshot is None:
+            return _Projection(status)
+        digest = snapshot.sha256
+    return _Projection("projected", (_ProjectedFile(relative, content, "write", digest),))
+
+
+def _edit(root: Path, tool_input: ObjectMapping) -> _Projection:
+    target = _target(root, string_value(tool_input.get("filePath")) or "")
+    old = string_value(tool_input.get("oldString"))
+    new = string_value(tool_input.get("newString"))
+    if target is None or not old or new is None:
+        return _Projection("invalid")
+    path, relative = target
+    status, snapshot = _snapshot(path)
+    if snapshot is None:
+        return _Projection(status)
+    count = snapshot.content.count(old)
+    replace_all = tool_input.get("replaceAll") is True
+    if count == 0 or (not replace_all and count != 1):
+        return _Projection("invalid")
+    content = snapshot.content.replace(old, new, -1 if replace_all else 1)
+    return _Projection(
+        "projected", (_ProjectedFile(relative, content, "edit", snapshot.sha256),)
+    )
+
+
+def _parse_patch(text: str) -> tuple[_PatchSection, ...] | None:
+    lines = text.splitlines()
+    if len(lines) < 3 or lines[0] != "*** Begin Patch" or lines[-1] != "*** End Patch":
+        return None
+    headers: tuple[tuple[str, PatchOperation], ...] = (
+        ("*** Add File: ", "add"),
+        ("*** Update File: ", "update"),
+        ("*** Delete File: ", "delete"),
+    )
+    sections: list[_PatchSection] = []
+    active: tuple[PatchOperation, str] | None = None
+    body: list[str] = []
+    for line in lines[1:-1]:
+        header = next(((kind, line.removeprefix(prefix).strip()) for prefix, kind in headers if line.startswith(prefix)), None)
+        if header is None:
+            if active is None:
+                return None
+            body.append(line)
+            continue
+        if active is not None:
+            sections.append(_PatchSection(*active, tuple(body)))
+        active = header
+        body = []
+    if active is None:
+        return None
+    sections.append(_PatchSection(*active, tuple(body)))
+    return tuple(sections)
+
+
+def _apply_update(source: str, lines: tuple[str, ...]) -> str | None:
+    chunks: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    old_lines: list[str] = []
+    new_lines: list[str] = []
+    for line in lines:
+        if line.startswith("@@"):
+            if old_lines:
+                chunks.append(("\n".join(old_lines), "\n".join(new_lines)))
+                old_lines, new_lines = [], []
+            continue
+        if line.startswith("+"):
+            new_lines.append(line[1:])
+        elif line.startswith("-"):
+            old_lines.append(line[1:])
+        else:
+            context = line[1:] if line.startswith(" ") else line
+            old_lines.append(context)
+            new_lines.append(context)
+    if old_lines:
+        chunks.append(("\n".join(old_lines), "\n".join(new_lines)))
+    if not chunks:
+        return None
+    result = source
+    for old, new in chunks:
+        if not old or result.count(old) != 1:
+            return None
+        result = result.replace(old, new, 1)
+    return result
+
+
+def _patch(root: Path, tool_input: ObjectMapping) -> _Projection:
+    sections = _parse_patch(string_value(tool_input.get("patchText")) or "")
+    if sections is None:
+        return _Projection("invalid")
+    files: dict[str, _ProjectedFile] = {}
+    for section in sections:
+        target = _target(root, section.path)
+        if target is None:
+            return _Projection("invalid")
+        path, relative = target
+        previous = files.get(relative)
+        if previous is None and section.operation != "add":
+            status, snapshot = _snapshot(path)
+            if snapshot is None:
+                return _Projection(status)
+            source, digest = snapshot.content, snapshot.sha256
+        elif previous is None:
+            if path.exists():
+                return _Projection("invalid")
+            source, digest = "", None
+        else:
+            source, digest = previous.content, previous.preimage_sha256
+        match section.operation:
+            case "add":
+                if previous is not None or any(not line.startswith("+") for line in section.lines):
+                    return _Projection("invalid")
+                content = "\n".join(line[1:] for line in section.lines) + "\n"
+            case "update":
+                updated = _apply_update(source, section.lines)
+                if updated is None:
+                    return _Projection("invalid")
+                content = updated
+            case "delete":
+                if section.lines:
+                    return _Projection("invalid")
+                content = ""
+        files[relative] = _ProjectedFile(relative, content, section.operation, digest)
+    return _Projection("projected", tuple(files.values()))
+
+
+def project_opencode_tool_input(
+    tool_name: str,
+    tool_input: ObjectMapping,
+    root: Path,
+    contract_version: str,
+) -> ObjectDict:
+    """Return projection metadata without mutating arguments or files."""
+    if contract_version != OPENCODE_TOOL_CONTRACT_VERSION:
+        return _Projection("unsupported").to_dict()
+    match tool_name.strip().lower():
+        case "write":
+            result = _write(root, tool_input)
+        case "edit":
+            result = _edit(root, tool_input)
+        case "apply_patch":
+            result = _patch(root, tool_input)
+        case _:
+            result = _Projection("unsupported")
+    return result.to_dict()
